refinement_policy: Refine four quarter-cell neighbors of floor-supported, non-overlapping coarse centers within 0.75m of an existing vertical structural collider AABB endpoint and with some saved OLD remaining conflict. Geometry only; before rendering. Include all 192 previous corner positions independently.
human_orientation_rule: Fixed world yaw zero for every independent stationary candidate scene; unchanged official upright rest pose.
bypass_rule: Both sides of nearest measured path tangent; 2m local strips, floor supported and conservative robot spheres at z=.65 with radius r_R+.05; human clearance >=.05. Discrete local diagnostic, not global planning.
render_policy: All 48 saved observation poses for every floor/overlap/bypass-valid candidate having any OLD remaining conflict, plus valid previous-region candidates. No ray visibility rejection. Other candidates have explicitly unmeasured visibility, not never-CLEAR labels.
paired_rgb_policy: Diagnostic only, no automatic leakage rejection. Previous 125 semantic-hidden renders all failed RGB thresholds (mean absolute variation 3.19-9.90/255); renderer variation is not evidence of human/shadow leakage. Inspect selected hidden RGB visually before freezing.
failure_counting: Multi-label A-G plus H insufficient hidden history; unrendered candidates separately reported. Exclusive primary reason priority E,D,F,B,H,C,A,G; not a severity ranking.
